records.title: Digital Asset Disclosures — XRP and cbXRP holdings/commercial engagement
records.summary: Coinbase says its holdings data are as of 31 March 2026 and defines 'Commercial Engagement' broadly to include financial engagements, business engagements and custody arrangements. In the US (including New York) trading-assets table, XRP is marked Coinbase Holding Yes / Commercial Engagement Yes. In the Coinbase Custody Trust Company table, XRP is Yes/Yes and cbXRP is Yes/Yes; RLUSD is No/Yes. The disclosure does not publish the XRP holding amount in this table.
records.limitations: Dated 31 March 2026, not current balances. 'Commercial Engagement' is broad and does not identify the specific engagement or amount. Holdings Yes does not reveal balance size.

records.title: Coinbase Wrapped Assets — 1:1 backing and cbXRP network support
records.summary: Coinbase states its wrapped assets are backed 1:1 by the underlying assets held in Coinbase custody. It lists Coinbase Wrapped XRP (cbXRP) as supported on Base. Depositing cbXRP to a Coinbase Exchange account is automatically unwrapped and credited as native XRP; withdrawing native XRP to a supported network can result in wrapped cbXRP. Coinbase's help page lists geographic restrictions for cbXRP send/receive, including Japan and New York State.
records.limitations: Product documentation is not an independent reserve audit. Availability is region-specific and can change; the restrictions page should not be treated as individualized legal advice.
